card_text: [On Play] Look at 4 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 "Cross Guild" type card or card with a type including "Baroque Works" other than [Mr.3(Galdino)] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
